Let go of everything that does not serve your highest purpose: allow yourself freedom from fear; let love guide every step instead - even if only for one moment! This will open up a world full of possibilities where anything is possible – including happiness and security, which can never come through external means or forces outside ourselves: but rather by simply allowing yourself to love who you are; without any need whatsoever for restrictions!
